neighbours.label: The split-off 'g' piece that opens '-gabe-' after a German prefix in a long compound (Ab|g|abe|frist, Rück|g|abe|schein, Aus|g|abe|stelle), vs compounds with the same prefixes and a different split piece (Ab|f|ahrts|zeit, Rück|f|ahr|karte)

quiet: Bitte beachten Sie, dass die Abfahrtszeit für den Bus im Juli früher ist.

predictions: The 'g' piece 0.4-1.0; same-prefix compounds without it under 0.15.
notes: Not probed: this pole was left out of the probe batch by mistake, and the procedure allows one batch, so the test is built from the card alone. Card: 'g' x5 and 'ge' x4: Ab|g|abetermin (-68), Rück|g|aberecht (-59.75), Auf|g|abengebiet (-57.75), Aus|g|abeposten (-57.25), Rat|ge|bers (-60.25); also ' a' in 'prune it into a whip' (-89.5). Tokenizer: the 'g' piece appears only in longer -gabe- compounds (Abgabe alone is Ab|gabe), so every fire item uses one; near misses use Ab|f|ahrt, Rück|f|ahr, Aus|fl|ug, Rück|kehr compounds.
